protocol.feasible: All four training cases: five-minute sampled steady RMS<=100m, steady peak<=500m, no collision/solver/clearance fault; first12h excluded from steady scoring
protocol.pareto: Nondominated feasible candidates on worst RMS, mean delta-v and mean burn count
protocol.selection: Report tightest, least fuel, fewest burns; primary minimizes worstRMS/50+meanDV/baselineDV+meanBurns/baselineBurns among RMS<=50m,peak<=300m if any, otherwise feasible set
protocol.precision: Primary only on September: <=1% relative RMS/DV change, <=10m steady peak change, <=1 burn-count change per case, no faults; choose lowest passing24/32width
protocol.evaluation: Selected distinct candidates and baseline float64, plus primary selected width on8fresh January cases; no holdout tuning
protocol.assumptions: Same500kg,.2N generic vehicle and synthetic fixes/noise/faults as prior campaign. No PIDfallback or future observed spacecraft data in guidance. Device unspecified.
